scope: Anonymous public DNS, certificate, HTTPS route, discovery file and runtime asset verification after domain cutover. No browser, Sites, account or website changes performed.

method.httpClient: Node.js built-in fetch; no authorization headers, cookie headers or cookie jar; standard TLS validation enabled
method.dns: dig against both authoritative name servers, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 and Google 8.8.8.8
method.comparison: Current website/dist for generated pages, sitemap and robots; website/public for static assets. HTML differences are ignored only when they exactly match the observed Cloudflare challenge-platform script before the closing body tag.
method.sampling: Point-in-time requests from this machine. This is not global propagation or ongoing uptime monitoring.
